raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner adopted a misleading snippet and concluded that “the first governor-general of India was Warren Hastings, appointed in 1784,” conflating the office of Governor-General of Bengal with Governor-General of India and giving the wrong date. This misinterpretation ignored conflicting information on the same results page (that Bentinck was the first official Governor-General of British India) and diverted the effort toward Hastings’ responsibilities instead of answering the question about the position (Governor-General of Bengal/Presidency of Fort William).
